authority: This registry records theory statements, their falsifiers and their current status. It grants no scientific status to anything it lists. A row marked SUPPORTED_AT_SCOPE is supported at that scope and nowhere else.

theories.statement: Touching a small fraction of a growing store, at matched correctness, is a signature of cognitive organisation rather than of ordinary filing.
theories.scope: finite competence stores addressed by a supplied family key, N up to about 2000
assumptions: the relevance key is available at query time
theories.resource_model: instrumented per-object touches; index build and maintenance charged separately
theories.predicted_observable: k, k/N and query work versus an ordinary index parent
theories.predicted_direction: the machine arm separates from the index parent on at least one coordinate
theories.strongest_parent: an ordinary database index keyed on the supplied family identity
theories.causal_ablation: global-scan arm with k equal to N
theories.negative_twin: cache parent, sparsest of all arms and unable to answer
theories.falsifier: the index parent matches on every coordinate
theories.evidence: results/SCALING_PILOT_V1.json: exact match on k, k/N, query work and correctness at every scale; the machine arm's persistent bytes are strictly larger
theories.reopen_condition: only under a relevance key the machine had to discover, which is TH-03

theories.statement: Given declared dependencies, revocation cost tracks the true dependency cone rather than the store size, and a genuinely global withdrawal is not disguised as local.
theories.scope: declared support graphs, N up to about 2000
assumptions: every dependency is declared at admission time
theories.field_identity: typed object graph with declared support edges
theories.resource_model: cone size, revision work, index maintenance
theories.predicted_observable: observed cone versus true cone for a local and a globally shared trigger
theories.predicted_direction: cone exact in both cases; local constant in N, global growing in N
theories.strongest_parent: truth maintenance; an audited O(N) scan over declared supports
theories.negative_twin: revocation of evidence that was never load-bearing
theories.falsifier: a cone that stays small when the true dependency is global
theories.evidence: results/SCALING_PILOT_V1.json: exact at every scale, local cone constant at 2, shared cone growing 21/61/201/601. Exactness is by construction because the graph was declared; the audited O(N) scan parent recovers both cones and was not run
theories.reopen_condition: under discovered rather than declared dependencies, which is TH-04 and TH-05

theories.statement: A relevance key adequate at one store size remains adequate as the store grows.
theories.scope: prediction-prefix keys over periodic rule stores, N from 17 to 481
assumptions: the key is fixed at design time
theories.resource_model: collision rate, maximum bucket, query work, index build and maintenance
theories.predicted_observable: collision rate of the hand-specified key across the scale sweep
theories.strongest_parent: the same index rebuilt on a richer feature
theories.negative_twin: a store that grows only in already-distinguished directions
theories.falsifier: collision rate rising materially with N
theories.evidence: results/SUBSPACE_E1_V1.json: collision rate 0 to 0.98 and maximum bucket 1 to 20 from N=17 to N=481, while correctness never moved because a colliding key is slower and never wrong. Noticing the decay cost more than it saved at the largest scale
theories.reopen_condition: an incremental re-index search, not run here, may change the cost side

theories.statement: Removing one piece of evidence at a time identifies everything a conclusion depends on.
theories.scope: induced periodic rules over evidence blocks, N from 80 to 800
theories.field_identity: typed object graph with declared support edges
theories.resource_model: re-inductions charged; precision and recall against a powerset oracle
theories.predicted_observable: fraction of methods whose support is invisible to single-element ablation
theories.strongest_parent: joint-witness search over subsets; a co-occurrence heuristic
theories.causal_ablation: simultaneous withdrawal of two individually redundant supports
theories.negative_twin: a method with a single genuine support, where the method is exact
theories.falsifier: a measurable population of methods with redundant support
theories.evidence: results/DEPEND_E3_V1.json: between 16.3% and 25% of methods have support no single-element ablation can see. An arm at perfect precision and recall against its own leave-one-out oracle still left a stale survivor under multi-block revocation
theories.reopen_condition: closed as stated; the successor statement is TH-05

theories.statement: The correct object of dependency discovery is the family of minimal support sets, and it can be identified under a bounded intervention budget by adaptive selection more cheaply than by exhaustive group ablation.
theories.scope: small evidence sets where the powerset oracle is exactly computable
theories.field_identity: typed object graph with declared support edges
theories.resource_model: interventions spent to reach a given support-family precision and recall
theories.predicted_observable: interventions versus adaptive, random and exhaustive selection
theories.predicted_direction: adaptive selection approaches the exhaustive ceiling at materially lower cost
theories.strongest_parent: ATMS minimal-environment labelling, which is expected to be sufficient when handed the justifications and is parent-owned since 1986
theories.causal_ablation: random group ablation under the same budget
theories.negative_twin: a family where no evidence is load-bearing
theories.falsifier: ATMS given the same interventions matches the adaptive arm

theories.statement: In a benchmark whose worlds are built by planting a known defect, the planted defect is a valid label for what the world requires.
theories.scope: escalation worlds under a nine-item perturbation menu, n=2000
theories.field_identity: registered repair lattice over representation, operators and formulation
theories.resource_model: not applicable; this is a construction-validity statement
theories.predicted_observable: agreement between the planted-defect label and the minimum repair recovered by exhaustive search over the repair lattice
theories.strongest_parent: none applicable; exhaustive repair search is ground truth by definition in a finite world
theories.negative_twin: zero-perturbation worlds, where both labels agree trivially
theories.falsifier: material disagreement between planted intent and minimum repair
theories.evidence: results/ESCALATION_INDEPENDENT_E4_V1.json: agreement on 53.4% of worlds, overstating the requirement 759 times and understating it 173 times. One repair can fix two defects; neither defect alone determines the requirement
theories.reopen_condition: the mechanism is general; the percentage is menu-specific and would need re-measuring for a different perturbation menu

theories.statement: Requiring an exhibited obstruction is what prevents false escalation, as distinct from any other principled trigger.
theories.scope: 2000 blindly perturbed worlds levelled by an independent repair oracle
theories.resource_model: false escalations and accuracy at matched information
theories.predicted_observable: false escalation rate of the witness policy versus an exact repair planner
theories.predicted_direction: the witness policy is strictly better
theories.strongest_parent: an exact repair planner testing each repair in cost order
theories.negative_twin: worlds needing no escalation at all
theories.falsifier: the planner also reaches zero false escalations
theories.evidence: results/ESCALATION_INDEPENDENT_E4_V1.json: both principled arms reach zero false escalations. The witness requirement is not what buys it. What survives is the weaker and still useful TH-08
theories.reopen_condition: in settings where the repair lattice is not enumerable, the planner is unavailable and the comparison changes

theories.statement: Escalating on exhaustion, on a stalled search, or on any counterexample produces false escalation at a material rate that a principled trigger removes at no accuracy cost.
theories.scope: 2000 blindly perturbed worlds levelled by an independent repair oracle
assumptions: ground truth is the minimum sufficient repair level
theories.resource_model: false escalations, missed escalations, exact-match accuracy
theories.predicted_observable: false escalation counts across five policies
theories.predicted_direction: zero for principled policies, materially positive for the three heuristics
theories.strongest_parent: the exact repair planner, which also reaches zero
theories.causal_ablation: the three heuristic policies under identical visible state
theories.negative_twin: zero-perturbation worlds, where all five policies are perfect
theories.falsifier: a heuristic policy reaching zero false escalations
theories.evidence: results/ESCALATION_INDEPENDENT_E4_V1.json: 0 for both principled arms against 232, 232 and 245 for saturation, refinement and timeout, with 22 accuracy points on top. Replicates a 0-versus-21 and 0-versus-14 asymmetry recorded earlier in the programme
theories.reopen_condition: an independently authored world family, still outstanding under #144 §11

theories.statement: Reusable methods can be discovered by mining repeated flat surface fragments from solved episodes.
assumptions: useful structure recurs at the surface level
theories.resource_model: candidate pool size, admitted methods, fresh-task search
theories.predicted_observable: size of the admitted method pool
theories.strongest_parent: anti-unification; Stitch-style corpus compression; DreamCoder library induction
theories.negative_twin: episodes with genuinely no shared structure
theories.falsifier: an empty pool despite independently checked sound fragments
theories.evidence: research/math-language-learning-v1/ASSAY-ACQUISITION-DIAGNOSIS.md: 21 attempts, three independently checked essential fragments, all singletons, terminal NO_METHOD_ACQUIRED. The stated cause is that flat queried fragments differ while the intermediate dependency step recurs
theories.reopen_condition: closed as stated; the successor statement is TH-10

theories.statement: Latent reusable structure that is invisible at the surface is recoverable at the level of proof steps, by anti-unification over normalised steps plus semantic-equivalence clustering, and survives persistence, restart and causal invocation.
theories.scope: propositional clause worlds where flat fragments are pairwise distinct by construction
assumptions: the recurring object is a parameterised resolution step
theories.resource_model: discovery cost, fresh-task search, checker calls, persistent bytes
theories.predicted_observable: schemas admitted, and fresh-task work against the reset arm
theories.predicted_direction: non-empty pool, and work reduction that disappears under method removal
theories.strongest_parent: DreamCoder-style library induction and Stitch-style compression, both of which can in principle find step-level structure if the traces expose it
theories.causal_ablation: remove the discovered schema and re-run the fresh tasks
theories.negative_twin: false-common-pattern schemas that recur by chance and do not help held-out tasks
theories.falsifier: library learning finds the same schemas, or no schema survives independent checking

theories.statement: Failure learning is not primitive: it decomposes into CHECK-failure, REVISE and CONSOLIDATE, and a truth-maintenance parent therefore reproduces it.
theories.scope: seven worlds with the failure cause supplied, and 59 episodes with it withheld
assumptions: the cause taxonomy is registered in advance
theories.field_identity: typed object graph with declared support edges
theories.resource_model: repeated wasted work, false exclusions, missed reopenings, probe cost
theories.predicted_observable: whether a nogood or decision-tree parent matches the governed store
theories.empirical_rung: #143 CL-2 / lane failure pilot and E2
theories.strongest_parent: a full-strength nogood store; a fixed near-optimal probe decision tree
theories.negative_twin: a checker defective in one scope and sound in another
theories.falsifier: a coordinate on which no parent reproduces the behaviour
theories.evidence: results/FAILURE_PILOT_V1.json: the nogood parent ties on four of seven worlds and avoids all 640 avoidable work units. results/DIAGNOSIS_E2_V1.json: the governed greedy rule provably reproduces the hand-authored decision tree ordering; the residual is 42 probe units of 573 and is memoisation
theories.reopen_condition: a setting where probe semantics must be learned rather than authored

theories.statement: As materially different domains are added, the number of genuinely new primitive operators required trends toward zero while learned macros continue to grow.
theories.scope: not yet testable: the programme has one domain family
assumptions: an operator basis has been frozen
theories.resource_model: new primitives admitted per domain versus new macros admitted
theories.strongest_parent: production systems, ACT-R production compilation, library learning
theories.negative_twin: a domain that requires a genuinely new primitive
theories.falsifier: persistent non-zero primitive pressure across held-out domains
theories.evidence: none; recorded so that the curve is instrumented from the first real run rather than reconstructed afterwards, per #145 GUO-D7
theories.reopen_condition: testable once a basis is frozen and a second domain family exists

theories.statement: The choice of field organisation materially changes how easily reusable methods are discovered, how small an operator basis suffices, and what exact revision costs.
theories.scope: matched exact tasks under at least three field organisations
theories.field_identity: flat store, typed graph, hypergraph, fibred field, TMS substrate
theories.operator_basis_identity: the same registered operator contracts across fields
theories.predicted_observable: method discovery rate, operator basis size, revision cost per field
theories.predicted_direction: no universal winner is assumed; a Pareto family is an admissible result
theories.strongest_parent: a flat relational store, which is the simplest and must be beaten on total cost
theories.causal_ablation: same tasks, same operators, field swapped
theories.negative_twin: a task family where field structure is irrelevant
theories.falsifier: the flat store matches every field on every coordinate
theories.evidence: not started; this is the next tranche after E5 and E6

theories.statement: Method reuse fails because reusable structure is not discovered; fix the discovery level and reuse follows.
theories.scope: checked unary-language proof episodes, four episodes, sixteen development trials
assumptions: the task ecology contains targets that require the discovered method
theories.resource_model: candidate pool size, method uses, matching work
theories.predicted_observable: uses of a method once discovery is repaired
theories.strongest_parent: the flat miner, which acquires nothing at all
theories.causal_ablation: donor off versus donor on, identical inputs
theories.negative_twin: episodes with no shared structure, where both arms acquire nothing
theories.falsifier: a repaired discovery mechanism that acquires a method which is then never used
theories.evidence: research/math-language-learning-v1/CLAUSE-REVIVAL-RESULT.md: with the clause donor on, episode 0's pool goes from 0 to 1, so step-level abstraction does fix discovery. The acquired rule's sixteen development trials then all report NO_MATCH: zero uses, zero query-constraint benefit, 4425 matching-work units, terminal NO_DEVELOPMENT_BENEFIT. Only rows 0/2/4/8 were eligible and every one of those targets is a Boolean tautology, so there was no essential composite target opportunity among the sixteen tasks
theories.reopen_condition: the successor statement is TH-15: opportunity, not discovery, is the binding constraint, and it needs an ecology with genuinely composite targets plus a tautological control

theories.statement: Once discovery is repaired, whether a learned method pays depends on whether the task ecology contains targets that essentially require it, and an ecology of tautologies or bypassable targets yields zero benefit from a correctly discovered method.
theories.scope: clause worlds with a registered essential-composite condition and a tautological control
assumptions: the discovered method is independently checked and sound
theories.resource_model: method uses, matching work, fresh-task search against a reset arm
theories.predicted_observable: uses and work reduction under essential-composite versus tautological ecologies at identical discovery
theories.predicted_direction: benefit in the first, zero in the second
theories.strongest_parent: DreamCoder and Stitch style library learning, which face the same ecology
theories.causal_ablation: remove the method and re-run the essential-composite tasks
theories.negative_twin: the tautological ecology itself, where zero benefit is the correct outcome
theories.falsifier: benefit that is indifferent to whether the target essentially requires the method, which would mean the measured gain was retrieval rather than composition
theories.evidence: not yet run; the experiment intended to test it was cancelled before producing a receipt, and no result should be read into its absence
